definitions.consistency_error: Q1 normal but Q2 defect, or Q1 anomalous but Q2 normal; over images with both answers valid
definitions.joint_accuracy: Q1 and Q2 both correct; invalid counts as wrong; over all images
definitions.false_defect_rate: normal images whose valid Q2 answer is a defect type; over normal images

source: same conventions as scripts/evaluate.py; each question was asked independently
